items.title: Lantern Cartographer
items.desc: A route witness who maps the places where rain and memory stop agreeing.

items.title: Root Tender
items.desc: A memory gardener pruning roots that repeat erased names.

items.title: Cinder Antler
items.desc: An ash-and-bone grazer whose broken antler still remembers fire.

items.title: Ledger Moth Swarm
items.desc: Paper-winged moths orbiting a ledger core full of unfiled names.

items.title: Route Map Seller
items.desc: A market route seller carrying maps that the ledgers refuse to acknowledge.

items.title: Rail Root Tender
items.desc: A railway gardener keeping memory-roots from swallowing the abandoned line.

items.title: Edge Cartographer
items.desc: A hooded scout mapping roads that forget how to continue at the Seam.

items.title: Void Root Tender
items.desc: A quiet gardener preserving one living seed beside the BL-07 vault.

items.title: Cinder Antler Variant
items.desc: An ash-bone deer with a void-lit rib cage and a burnt branching crown.

items.title: Ledger Moth Swarm Variant
items.desc: Parchment moths circling a bound memory ledger like a living warning.

items.title: Sealed-Note Seller
items.desc: A Verdan broker whose sealed notes, brass key, and worn coat carry the market's quiet debt.

items.title: Rain-Ledger Scribe
items.desc: A route scribe keeping two records at once: the written road and the one rain leaves behind.

items.title: Ash Netter
items.desc: A salt-coast forager with a memory net, weathered pack, and a name for every piece the tide returns.

items.title: Quiet Healer
items.desc: A Seam medic carrying a small lantern and folded remedies for wounds no ledger can classify.

items.title: Threshold Warden
items.desc: A boundary watcher reading the first signs of a voice that has learned to wear a fear.

items.title: Root Listener
items.desc: A forest witness listening for the unfinished story inside the memory-roots.

items.title: Belt Scavenger
items.desc: An iron-clad rail scavenger assembled from straps, hooks, and the last useful things left on the line.

items.title: Signal Wisp
items.desc: A violet signal-flame caught in a torn cloak, calling travelers toward routes that no longer exist.

items.title: Ash Hound
items.desc: A lean charcoal hound with ember eyes and a rib-lit memory of the road it once guarded.

items.title: Rootbound Echo
items.desc: A broken figure held upright by roots, repeating a borrowed gesture from someone already erased.

items.title: Colorless Wraith
items.desc: A pale, hollow wraith whose missing color gathers at the face like a memory refusing to resolve.

items.title: Void Fragment
items.desc: A sharp shard of the Void wrapped in a torn shell, pulsing with restrained violet pressure.
